choices.text: A resemblance. The world is full of hospitable islanders.
Invite him to breakfast too. Doubt starves at a full table.

nodes.text: Dantès? Did I know poor dear Edmond? Why, Edmond Dantès and myself were intimate friends!
He died a more wretched, hopeless, heart-broken prisoner than the felons who pay the penalty of their crimes at the galleys of Toulon.
I was called to see him on his dying bed, that I might administer to him the consolations of religion.

title: Franz — the man who remembers Sinbad
